dialogues.speaker: Yizheng
dialogues.text: Greetings! I'm Yizheng, one of the workers here at the dock. I'm in charge of short-distance transport of small items between Qingce Village and Chenyu Vale.

dialogues.speaker: Yizheng
dialogues.text: As you can see, Wangshu Inn is just up ahead. That's where this route ends.

dialogues.speaker: Yizheng
dialogues.text: But I haven't been able to visit it via boat because I get seasick easily.

dialogues.speaker: Yizheng
dialogues.text: I've heard the food there is really good, though.
